body.title: Mirror DocGenOutcome<T> as a hand-written MCP JSON schema
body.summary: Hand-author the JSON schema for the generic DocGenOutcome<T> union so the MCP output surface validates all six status variants under exactOptionalPropertyTypes, wired to the actual registered docgen tool.
acceptanceChecks: a JSON schema exists that validates one sample payload for each of the 6 DocGenOutcome status variants (ok, empty-scope, not-found, truncated, fallback-unavailable, source-not-ready)
the schema is wired to the MCP output surface for the docgen tool's response, against the tool as actually registered in t7
